messages:
alex: quick q — audit retention for automatic fallback decisions. current default is 7d but ops is asking for 90d for legal/forensics. want opinions on tradeoffs

maya: 7d was chosen to limit storage + PII surface. are we talking full prompt retention or just decision metadata?

alex: full prompt + route decision + model id + latency/error metrics. ops wants longer for postmortems.

julian: proposal: separate "decision trace" (route, signals, score, model_version) from "payloads" (prompt/text). keep traces longer, archive payloads with redaction.

sara: +1. also need exportable archive for legal hold. prefer TTL override per org/policy.

kevin: cost flag here. full prompts * 100M reqs/month = nontrivial. recommend sampled full payloads + full trace for every request.

deploy-bot: snapshot created for rollout:policy-723 at 2026-03-05T14:12:33Z :white_check_mark:

maya: UX idea: retention slider in policy editor (7d / 30d / 90d / custom) with live estimate: GB/mo and cost. add redact toggle: none / prompt_text / prompt_hash.

alex: what about replay capability? ops wants to replay a decision with sanitized prompt to reproduce issue.

julian: replay approach: store sanitized prompt + decision_trace + model_seed/meta. can reconstruct with pinned model version. privacy caveat: replayable prompts are sensitive.

sara: audit store must be immutable + access-logged. add checksum + S3 object-level logs. UI must show who accessed exports.

maya: for compliance, keep tenant-separated archives. add an approval flow for engineers requesting access (reason + TTL on access).

alex: UX question: org default vs per-policy retention? my vote: org default + per-policy override. keeps setup simple but flexible.

kevin: per-policy override is required for enterprise customers that will contract for 365d. also need quota protection to prevent runaway storage.

maya: API fields we need: `retention_days`, `redact_level`, `audit_sampling_rate`. small example:
```
{
  "policy_id": "auto-fallback-723",
  "retention_days": "90",
  "redact_level": "prompt_text",
  "audit_sampling_rate": "0.05"
}
```

julian: add `decision_only_mode=true` to keep only traces. also add `archive_after_days` to push cold data to cheaper storage and `immutable_crc` for integrity.

sara: UI should surface expected storage + last-accessed + a link to export. also show a warning when retention > org default.

kevin: telemetry hooks: emit `fallback.audit.size_bytes`, `fallback.audit.retained_count`, `fallback.audit.replay_requests`. useful for billing and alerts.

maya: I'll draft a spec doc with wireframes. should include cost calc, sample rates, and redaction options.

alex: i can take first pass on spec wording + UX copy. cc @julian @kevin for review. thanks all :heart:
